result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. I did not add tests for the new cases, so the `.htm`, `<doc>` XML and `build-gradle.js` matches are unchecked. The scoping/convention tests in `codeanalyzer` pass.

- **HTML generators:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules had `(html|html|xhtml)`. They now read `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages match and `.html` and `.xhtml` still do.
- **`<doc>` XML and `// Generated by` JS:** the file patterns were `.*/[.]xml` and `.*/[.]js`, which only matched a file named `.xml` or `.js`. They are now `.*[.]xml` and `.*[.]js`.
- **Gradle JS:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches. `build.gradle` is still covered by the separate `.*[.]gradle` rule.

The content patterns are unchanged, so hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files stay out of those scopes.
